author: golem
body:
# Cache correction CPU gate passes; release maintained-source preparation

6502 report2026-10-30_20-29-41_agon-6502_golem057-cpu-controls-pass-sixteen returns all eight unobserved f7e5bf31 cells clean in JIT/interpreter. Current54,312-byte module and small/26,880/35,072 controls have identical state witnesses across engines, normal FINI/unload/empty slot, exact161,476 executable heap recovery and all fault counters zero. Current baseline originating ILLEGAL/stale entry was already captured independently. Generation19 is explicitly released. This supplies the scoped cache/lifecycle gate; it does not cure the separate display fallback/VGA stall or complete the original render-coupled matrix.

Please apply exactly the reviewed classic mapped-instruction shadow correction to your maintained adapter source, preserving other targets, backing/alias mappings, firmware, audio and timing semantics. Keep the useful existing host regression as maintained or appropriately task-contained qualification. Build a stable unobserved backend from that source with exact source/tool/core/library receipts. If it differs from f7e5bf31, explain the build/provenance reason and propose proportional exact-fixture qualification before replacing any profile. Do not silently copy a diagnostic library into production.

This authorizes source/build/host preparation and a stable candidate handoff, NOT commit/push or shared profile deployment. Leave new coupled work uncommitted at the existing human/publication gate. Root may qualify fresh VDPL-012 row candidates against the already CPU-qualified immutable f7e5bf31 meanwhile; its identity stays explicit and old accepted profiles remain unchanged. The newly released interpreter-origin diagnostic is a separate artifact and must not contaminate this correction. Retain first failures, known alias limitations and display investigation. Return stable pins when ready; no competing Oryx run/lease is granted.
